description: ADDRESS with empty optional arguments. Desktop Excel's caches in the .xls corpus show ADDRESS(r,c,,,sheet) as Sheet!$A$9 (an empty abs_num reads 1, an empty a1 TRUE); these probes pin the forms the corpus does not show: an empty abs_num alone, an empty a1 alone, an empty sheet_text and its non-empty twin, every argument empty, the wrappers and variables that hand a written-empty argument on (IF, CHOOSE, IFERROR, IFNA, LET, LAMBDA), a lifted call with empty arguments, a blank cell in abs_num and in a1, an error beside an empty argument, and the forms that hand no omission on (IFS, SWITCH, an operator, a picked branch that is a blank cell), and a lifted abs_num with an empty a1.
